$comment: v0.1 genre enum. Widen only alongside content that uses the new value (see docs/maintain/authoring.md); must stay equal to schemas/defs.schema.json#/$defs/genre. delivery decides where a convention practice for this genre is rendered: 'core' means it can appear in core/*.md (because the genre is written without reading a file), 'skill' means it belongs in a plugins/writing-compass skill's generated references.
